name: Vercel

onboarding.notes: Send the link to the template(s) and a short in-product video of the flow that uses Domain Connect. The template must also be published to the Templates repository and must set syncPubKeyDomain.

notes: Every synchronous apply request must be signed (RSA-SHA256). redirect_uri is required, must be HTTPS and must match syncRedirectDomain. Supported record types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, CAA, SPFM, SRV, NS; a CNAME on the apex is created as an ALIAS record. Template support can be checked at https://vercel.com/api/domain-connect/v2/domainTemplates/providers/{providerId}/services/{serviceId}.
